description: A Botcopy rich reply. Compose the whole reply in one call.

botcopy.description: The components of this reply, rendered in order.

items.description: One rendered component. Set one property here, and add another array element for the next component.

displayText.description: The text shown in the chat bubble. Always set this.

ssml.description: Optional SSML markup for spoken output.

textToSpeech.description: Optional phrase spoken aloud. Takes priority over ssml.

suggestions.description: Quick-reply chips shown under the reply.

action.description: Exactly one of message, link, or location.

command.description: The training phrase or event name sent to the agent.

type.description: Send "training" for a training phrase or "event" for an event name.

parameters.description: Optional key and value pairs sent to the agent alongside the command.

message.description: Continue the conversation by sending a command back to the agent. Use type "training" for a training phrase or "event" for an event name.

target.description: Where to open the link. Omit this to open it in the Botcopy webview.

parameters.description: Optional key and value pairs appended to the link.

link.description: Open a URL. Omit target to open it in the Botcopy webview.

success.description: The action taken once the user shares their location.

error.description: The action taken if the user declines or the lookup fails.

parameter.description: Variable name that receives the location result.

errorCode.description: Variable name that receives the error code.

latitude.description: Variable name that receives the latitude.

longitude.description: Variable name that receives the longitude.

location.description: Ask the user to share their location, then continue with the success or error message action.
